name: Search messages
description: The action that searches messages in a user's mailbox using InternetMessageId and/or NetworkMessageId

email_local_id.description: The local message identifier mapped from email.local_id (Graph NetworkMessageId)

email_message_id.description: The message identifier mapped from email.message_id (Graph internetMessageId / Internet Message-ID RFC 5322)

item_index.description: The zero-based index of the candidate to select in returned messages

most_recent.description: The option that sorts candidates by receivedDateTime descending when true

top.description: The maximum number of messages to return

user.description: The user identifier or user principal name (UPN)

has_more.description: The indicator that is true when Graph indicates additional pages may exist

message_id.description: The selected Microsoft Graph message item ID, or null when no result is found
The Microsoft Graph message item ID

network_message_id.description: The NetworkMessageId extracted from Graph extended properties when available

query_type.description: The identifier type used for the search

query_value.description: The search identifier value, or concatenated values when both identifiers are provided

returned_count.description: The alias of total_results for explicit count-based playbook conditions

selected_index.description: The selected index in the returned messages list, or null when no result is found

selected_message.description: The selected message object, or null when no result is found

total_results.description: The number of messages returned in this response

user.description: The echo of the user identifier used for this action, reusable in downstream playbook nodes
